video_title: 48 Hours with Alex Sarr Before the NBA Season

quotes.speaker: Alex Sarr
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr on his daily routine and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: We do like them every day, probably like six days of the week, and then during the season
quotes.quote: We do like them every day, probably like six days of the week, and then during the season because we're away. We're probably home for like four or five days of the week. We got a chef at the facility on the road. Before the games, we have like a little pasta station. They make your pasta two hours before the game. Along me, you guys all know each other. We met at like high school, six or seven years, you know.

quotes.speaker: James Davis
quotes.summary_phrase: James Davis on Alex Sarr's training focus
quotes.excerpt: Alex's training right now is just focusing on strength and power, the things that make you athletic.
quotes.quote: Alex's training right now is just focusing on strength and power, the things that make you athletic. Those are the things we work on, and then three times a week we do more of a tendon load and mobility session. As far as assessment and reassessment goes from a strength standpoint, we progressively load all of our lifts, and we have a few main lifts that we do pretty much all the time. I'll actually use a dynamometer for some of the lifts.

quotes.speaker: Alex Sarr
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr on player ratings in NBA 2K
quotes.excerpt: He's a little underrated. He's not very good. I mean, he's all right, he's just too slow.
quotes.quote: He's a little underrated. He's not very good. I mean, he's all right, he's just too slow. They made him like, I should be way faster than that. By the end of the season, I think we'll be like probably around like at least 87, 88.

quotes.speaker: Alex Sarr
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr on team goals for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: Obviously, you know, we have a lot of new pieces coming along, so just building that chemistry.
quotes.quote: I'm very excited. Obviously, you know, we have a lot of new pieces coming along, so just building that chemistry, growing as a team, and doing better than we did last year, that's the main goal.

quotes.speaker: Alex Sarr
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr on playing with experienced teammates
quotes.excerpt: Having more experienced players is going to help us play maybe like a slower type of basketball.
quotes.quote: Having more experienced players is going to help us play maybe like a slower type of basketball sometimes in the half court, but also playing on our strength because we're still a young team that's very athletic. So it's going to be a good mix of both.

quotes.speaker: Alex Sarr
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr on AJ Dybantsa's potential impact
quotes.excerpt: I think he'll be very impactful as far as him getting downhill and also creating shots.
quotes.quote: Seeing him play in the runs, it's been very cool to see just him getting more and more comfortable as time goes on. I think he'll be very impactful as far as him getting downhill and also creating shots for himself, but Trae and all the players on the team can create shots for him too, so I'm very excited to see that.

quotes.speaker: Alex Sarr
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr on the importance of rebounding
quotes.excerpt: I think the game is a rebounding battle. It's about how many possessions we can get offensively.
quotes.quote: I think the game is a rebounding battle. It's about how many possessions we can get offensively, how many we can avoid the other team to get in securing the defensive rebound and projecting us on the fast break. We brought the right guys for that.

quotes.speaker: Alex Sarr
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr on his positional versatility
quotes.excerpt: I think it will be wherever I fit. I think Anthony Davis is very versatile, I'm very versatile.
quotes.quote: I think it will be wherever I fit. I think Anthony Davis is very versatile, I'm very versatile, so it just depends on what the mismatch is, what the matchup is, what the coaches is for that night.

quotes.speaker: Alex Sarr
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr on lessons learned from his injury
quotes.excerpt: Even if you're hurt or you're not able to work as 100% as you usually would, you can.
quotes.quote: Even if you're hurt or you're not able to work as 100% as you usually would, you can still get better in many ways. Being hurt allows you to take a step back and kind of appreciate it even more this season and the grind of when you're healthy. It makes you grateful for what you got and it gives you time to breathe and watch film, focus on other things. Obviously, you can still get bigger and gain the weight room, so that's what I've been mostly focused on for sure.

quotes.speaker: Jamir Watkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamir Watkins on his nickname for Alex Sarr
quotes.excerpt: Usually people call him Big Eiffel. I call him Son sometimes, little bro.
quotes.quote: Alex Sarr nickname. Usually people call him Big Eiffel. I call him Son sometimes, little bro. What else? You're forever going to be my son, bro. Like you know what it is, bro. I'm going to stay on top of you. I'm going to stay on top of you. I'm going to stay on top of you. But you're little bro, you know that.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Davis
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis and Alex Sarr discuss pranking teammates
quotes.excerpt: If you could prank someone, who would it be?

text_blocks.speaker: Anthony Davis
text_blocks.text: If you could prank someone, who would it be?

text_blocks.speaker: Alex Sarr
text_blocks.text: From the players? I'll prank Anthony Davis. I feel like he would be very bought in the prank.

text_blocks.speaker: Anthony Davis
text_blocks.text: You're talking to the guy. If you want to get it done, we can get it done. I just want to let you know that someone said they would prank you. I can't tell you who, but your name has come up. Trae Young is not the only guy that I'm interviewing. Your name has come up.

text_blocks.speaker: Alex Sarr
text_blocks.text: I think I think I knew. I could fake charity event. That sounds bad, but you know what I mean.

quotes.speaker: Alex Sarr
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr on LeBron James' eventual retirement
quotes.excerpt: I don't know if he'll ever retire honestly. I don't really see it happening soon.
quotes.quote: I don't know if he'll ever retire honestly. I don't really see it happening soon.
